total_assets.notes: Total assets, end of quarter (Schedule RC). Net of allowance for loan and lease losses.

average_assets_and_other_quarterly_avera.notes: Schedule RC-K quarterly averages. 3368 = quarterly average of total assets (average over the quarter of daily or weekly figures, per form instructions). Annual average assets may alternatively be formed from end-of-period total assets (2170) across quarters or years.

cash_and_balances_due.notes: 0010 = cash and balances due from depository institutions (total). From 1984: 0081 noninterest-bearing balances and currency and coin + 0071 interest-bearing balances (Schedule RC). Other codes are RC-A components on some forms.

overnight_money_fed_funds_sold_and_rever.notes: 1350 = federal funds sold and securities purchased under agreements to resell (combined). 0276/0277 separate fed funds sold and reverse repos; populated only from 1988 in these files.

securities.notes: 0390 = total investment securities, book value, excluding trading accounts (1984-1993). 0380 (all other bonds, stocks and securities) exists only in 1983Q4. 1754/1773 (held-to-maturity / available-for-sale) begin in 1994 and are empty in these files.

trading_accounts.notes: 2146 = assets held in trading accounts (from 1984). 1000 = trading account securities (pre-1984 concept; derived later). 3545 = trading assets (later form; empty here). 3401 = quarterly average of trading assets (RC-K).

real_estate_loans.notes: 1410 = loans secured by real estate (total). 1420 = secured by farmland (also relevant to an agricultural-lending concept). Components vary by form.

commercial_loans.notes: 1600 = commercial and industrial loans including acceptances of other banks (after 1984Q1 = 1755 + 1766 per Chicago Fed notes). 1766 = C&I loans excluding acceptances (= 1763 + 1764).

loans_to_individuals.notes: 1975 = loans to individuals for household, family and other personal expenditures (total). 2008 credit cards and related plans; 2011 other. 2010/2020/2070 are older component codes present only in early quarters.

agricultural_loans.notes: 1590 = loans to finance agricultural production and other loans to farmers (non-real-estate). 1420 = real estate loans secured by farmland (also part of 1410).

other_loans_and_leases_and_loan_totals.notes: Loans to depository institutions, other financial institutions, for purchasing securities, foreign governments, states and political subdivisions, all other loans, lease financing receivables; gross loans (1400), unearned income (2123), net of unearned income (2122), allowance (3123), allocated transfer risk reserve (3128), net loans (2125).

fixed_assets_premises.notes: Premises and fixed assets (including capitalized leases).

other_assets.notes: Other real estate owned (2150), investments in unconsolidated subsidiaries (2130), customers' liability on acceptances (2155), intangible assets (2143; goodwill 3163), other assets (2160), income earned not collected (2164; a component of other assets on some forms).

deposits.notes: 2200 = total deposits. RCFD = consolidated domestic+foreign offices; RCON = domestic offices; RCFN2200 = foreign offices. Component items vary by form.

liabilities_and_equity.notes: Total liabilities, equity capital and selected liability items, for balance-sheet checks.

income_statement.notes: Schedule RI. Income and expense items are calendar year-to-date cumulative amounts as of the report date (the December report holds the full calendar year). 4340 = net income; 4073 = total interest expense; 4093 = total noninterest expense; 4107 = total interest income; 4079 = total noninterest income; 4230 = provision; 4091 = securities gains/losses; 4302 = income taxes; 4320 = extraordinary items; 4150 = number of full-time-equivalent employees.
